source_semantics: O localization is a raw-keypoint prediction window with empirical CAL error radius; no occluder mask or mask intersection is passed to this producer.
A finite empirical maximum from7points/2sessions is not future coverage, a calibrated probability or an independent physical occlusion certificate.
Five failures can involve additional U/partial/canvas/visibility constraints. Releasing O alone is not proven sufficient, and no domain sizes are tuned or re-fitted here.
